laws.rule: Hegra (AlUla) can be visited only on an organised tour (coach or private premium 4x4), from SAR 95; self-driving is not allowed. Tours are limited each day, so pre-booking is highly recommended. (No RBA rate for SAR; at the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 2.64 SAR: SAR 95 ≈ A$35.98)
laws.heading: FAQ

laws.rule: Stay on the designated walking paths; entering non-designated areas, including the tombs, and touching the engravings is prohibited.

sites.name: Hegra (AlUla)
sites.what: Ancient city with monumental tombs, including Jabal Ithlib, Jabal Banat, the Tomb of Lihyan son of Kuza and Jabal Ahmar.

access.tickets: Organised tours from SAR 95 per person; pre-book.
access.permits: Tour only; self-driving not allowed; tombs closed to visitors.
